name: complete-shot
description: A drawing-led shot pipeline. Camera movement is support, never a substitute for performance or environmental action.

acceptance: Every shot has a canonical frame count, rate policy and source citation
Contradictory timing is surfaced for author decision and is never silently normalized
Character, prop, environment, effects and camera action are specified separately
Camera motion is not accepted as a substitute for character or environmental action
Resolution, fps, frame numbering, color, alpha, audio and codec contracts are explicit
Paths and names are deterministic and compatible with the repository
Validation commands test files without claiming creative approval
Every input has a stable ID, version, hash, provenance, rights state and review state
Rejected, exploratory and superseded material remains explicitly excluded
No duplicate or stale reference is silently promoted
Boards show each decisive action change, contact and reaction
Screen direction, eyelines, entrances, exits and sound cues are annotated
A still-image pan is not represented as completed animation
Camera, staging, scale, perspective and occlusion are unambiguous
Every active character, rigid prop and effects zone has a registered placement
The layout is 16:9 and preserves the script's moonless restrained setting
Age, silhouette, face, hair, costume and body proportions match approved references
Hands, grips and unseen views needed by the shot are explicitly resolved
No exploratory or unapproved atlas is promoted to canon
Canoes, paddles, drum and assigned props have locked dimensions, materials and required views
Grip points and articulating versus rigid parts are explicit
Culturally specific construction is preserved and geometry cannot drift between frames
The user's hand-inked angular and asymmetric visual language is preserved
Backgrounds are grounded and layered without invented lettering
Rigid objects and clean plates are separable from water and effects
Navy and steel shadows with copper-amber accents follow actual scene lighting
Skin pigment and character-local colors remain accurate
The image retains rich color, readable silhouettes and intentional ink texture
Foreground, midground, background and clean plates register to approved layout
Moonless river lighting preserves rich navy, steel and restrained amber without generic sunset
No incidental words, water seam or baked-in moving subject appears
The task explicitly recommends a bounded rig or no rig for each actor and prop
Any rig documents safe ranges, pivots, constraints and swap drawings
A no-rig recommendation routes substantial acting to replacement drawings rather than rubber-sheet deformation
Keys cover anticipation, contact, pressure, release and reaction where required
Skulls, torsos, hulls, paddles, drums and other rigid geometry remain stable
Every script-required actor and moving scene element has purposeful action
No whole-painting deformation, optical-flow morph or camera-only substitute is used
All keys are inspected for identity, volume, arcs, contacts and full-scene action
Corrections are expressed as redraws or explicit revisions, not hidden with deformation
Only accepted registered keys are released downstream
Spacing follows approved charts and preserves weight, arcs and contact locks
Character volume, face identity, grips and rigid props remain stable
Inconsistent upstream keys are blocked rather than averaged into warped frames
Clean lines preserve the author's variable-width handmade ink character
Construction noise is removed without replacing intentional hatching
All frames are registered and complete with no cropped hands, props or silhouettes
Approved palettes, skin colors, materials and cel-shadow planes are consistent
Alpha edges are clean and intentional ink and crosshatching remain visible
No generated lettering, logo, watermark or unintended color drift appears
Water, wakes, foam, roots, atmosphere and secondary motion follow the approved action brief
Effects stay inside their masks and never bend characters, hulls or rigid props
Wakes and particles travel independently instead of remaining glued to moving objects
Only approved registered drawings, plates, mattes and effects are assembled
Occlusion, exposure, independent layer rates and rigid geometry remain correct
No water seam, pulsing cutout, stuck wake, unplanned hold or camera-only motion remains
Dialogue, silence, ambience, effects and music intent map to exact frames
48 kHz stem layout, mix targets and temporary-versus-final rules are explicit
Missing rights, recordings or tools remain blockers rather than fabricated audio

artifact_kinds: authorized voice takes or no-dialogue determination
acceptance: Only exact approved dialogue is performed with documented authorization
No voice cloning, impersonation or invented speech is used
A shot with no dialogue receives an explicit no-dialogue determination instead of fake audio

artifact_kinds: edited dialogue stem or approved silence stem
acceptance: Authorized takes preserve performance and exact wording
Edits, cleanup, room tone and pickups are transparently documented
Missing speech is never synthesized or hidden
Contacts, water, wakes, atmosphere and supernatural cues align to exact frames
Sources are original or rights-cleared and placeholders are labeled
Effects support physical action without adding unrequested music

artifact_kinds: original music stems or approved silence decision
acceptance: Music or intentional silence follows approved dramatic beats
Any music is original or rights-cleared with separable stems
Caribbean and Bronx identity is treated specifically without generic trailer scoring or pastiche
Dialogue or silence, effects, ambience and music align sample-accurately to picture
Dynamics are preserved and stems remain separable
Processing does not hide missing assets, sync failures or temporary sources
Canonical shot order, full frame counts, cut rhythm and 16:9 framing are preserved
Audio and picture remain synchronized and temporary elements are labeled
Missing coverage is reported rather than hidden with repetition or still holds
Every delivery file traces to approved inputs and reviewed stage outputs
Hashes, versions, rights, shot usage and supersession links are complete
Rejected and exploratory files are absent from the delivery graph
Motion is watched at speed and frame-stepped at contacts, occlusions and cuts
Identity, anatomy, weight, rigid props, mattes, color, sound and full-scene action pass
A successful decode, test suite or contact sheet alone is not treated as animation approval
